1. **`formatBytes(n)`** in `src/util.js` — Converts byte counts to human-readable strings (B, KB, MB, GB) with one decimal place.
2. **`slugify(title)`** in `src/text.js` — Converts strings to URL-friendly slugs: lowercase, trimmed, space-runs replaced with dashes, non-alphanumeric characters stripped.
3. **`fetchUsers(baseUrl)`** in `src/api.js` — Fetches the user array from the API endpoint, logs the fetch count, and returns the array.

All functions are exported from their respective modules.
